explanations: The reschedule handler builds the moved appointment itself and saves it straight to the repository, skipping AppointmentService. The slot rules (15-minute grid, opening hours, no double-booking) live only in the service's checkSlot, so a patient can move onto a taken slot or outside opening hours. The handler can read the repository to check ownership, but writes must go through the business layer. The fix calls service.move(appt.id, { start }) and maps its SlotError to 409/422 the same way book does. Then every way of changing a slot, including the coverage job, enforces the same rules.
